rationale: Excluded (E07): The paper is a technical overview and doctrinal legal review of European Union legislation (such as End-of-Waste, REACH, permitting, and fertiliser regulations) governing commercial phosphorus recovery from wastewater streams for fertiliser production. It concerns industrial resource recovery and fertiliser market penetration for treatment plant operators, startups, and the fertiliser sector rather than household or community water or sanitation service access, lacks empirical primary data or a systematic synthesis, and measures no domestic service-access outcomes.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Although the paper examines EU legislation, permitting, and regional administrative decision-making under the broad literal Criterion 2 reading, those rules govern industrial phosphorus recovery and fertiliser marketing rather than household or community water or sanitation service access; the record is excluded under both readings due to failing Criteria 1, 3, and 4.

evidence_quotes.quote: From wastewater to fertilisers - Technical overview and critical review of European legislation governing phosphorus recycling
The present paper is based on an analysis of the EU legislation regulating phosphorus recovery and recycling from wastewater stream, in particular as fertiliser.
Legislation harmonisation, inclusion of recycled phosphorus in existing fertiliser regulations and support of new operators would speed up market penetration of novel technologies
